description: This file contains the implementation of the SimplePie library, a PHP-based RSS and Atom feed framework. It defines constants, namespace URIs, and the core class SimplePie with methods for parsing, fetching, and handling feeds, including caching, autodiscovery, and customization options.

classes.name: SimplePie
classes.description: Core class for parsing, fetching, and manipulating RSS and Atom feeds with customizable options, caching, autodiscovery, and extension support.

classes.name: SimplePie_Item
classes.description: Represents individual feed items, providing methods to access item-specific data such as title, description, links, categories, enclosures, and metadata.

classes.name: SimplePie_Source
classes.description: Provides methods to access source metadata, including title, categories, authors, and related links associated with a feed item.

classes.name: SimplePie_Author
classes.description: Represents an author with name, link, and email details.

classes.name: SimplePie_Category
classes.description: Represents a category with term, scheme, and label.

classes.name: SimplePie_Enclosure
classes.description: Encapsulates media enclosure data, including URL, type, length, and media-specific attributes.
